authority_blockers.reason: P4/P5 high-level scope is frozen by Canonical and the M8 runway, but exact subject/composition identity, role/privacy projection, instructor approval/audit semantics, machine-vs-human evidence separation, aggregation/profile authority, cross-layer DTOs, exact API/GUI projections and C4 admission evidence require machine-authority closure before dependent P4/P5 implementation may claim completion.

batches.name: P5 team/mission + exact publication/security + M9 runway

tasks.minimum_acceptance: Versioned machine authority freezes exact P4 subject and P5 composition identities, role/privacy projections, instructor annotation/approval/audit semantics, machine-vs-human evidence separation, explicit unavailable/OOD/not-identifiable semantics, governed aggregation/profile identity, exact cross-layer DTOs and C4 admission evidence. No implementation-local formula, threshold, weight, role rule or alias is permitted.

tasks.deliverable: C4 P4/P5 admission and claim guard
tasks.minimum_acceptance: P4/P5 remain externally unclaimable until protected-main M8 Exit GO; P1/P2/P3 stay immutable distinct evidence layers; P6 remains inactive; exact P3 claim level/validity/as-of/uncertainty is preserved without upgrade.

Materialize exact governed subject or pseudonymous subject key, role/seat/function, aircraft_id, exact twin_revision_id and optional exact P3 estimate_id, session/episode/stage scope, configuration/evidence refs and as-of cutoff; no current/latest/default or hidden P3 recomputation.

Freeze exact World/event/evidence references consumed by P4/P5 while keeping facts, machine evidence, instructor annotation and assessment products distinct; same-episode/future-information leakage and fact mutation fail closed.

Create deterministic composition identity binding team/package/mission scope, participant subject IDs, roles, aircraft IDs, exact twin revisions, relevant P4 revision refs, scenario/mission context and valid/as-of interval; any composition change creates a new identity.

Freeze least-privilege role matrix and projection rules for subject/self, instructor/evaluator, team lead, analyst and administrator/auditor; direct identity is minimized, privileged access is auditable, and sensitive evidence is excluded from unrestricted client logs/exports.

tasks.deliverable: P4/P5 authority, admission, privacy, leakage and composition Golden-negative suite
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Fail closed on missing/stale authority, current/latest/default resolution, future/same-episode leakage, unauthorized identity/evidence projection, composition drift under one identity, OOD/unavailable zero coercion, P3 claim upgrade, individual/team scope copy and premature P4/P5/P6 admission.

Create immutable evidence products for only authority-approved human-machine evidence families, bound to exact subject/context/P3/World provenance and as-of cutoff; no unapproved metric formula or derived score is invented.

tasks.deliverable: Immutable instructor annotation and approval revision workflow
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Author/role/time/target revision/review state are exact; update creates immutable audit-preserving revision/supersession rather than overwriting machine evidence or prior published decisions; write semantics are idempotent and authorized.

Publish deterministic P4 assessment identity with exact subject, evidence, instructor/machine origin, approval state, P3 refs, validity/as-of, uncertainty/status and provenance; unsupported or unavailable evidence remains explicit and is never fabricated as zero.

tasks.deliverable: P4 longitudinal identity, supersession and replay
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Historical individual assessments remain exact-revision addressable; subject/role/configuration/assessment-profile changes preserve boundaries; longitudinal comparison uses only governed comparable identities and exact as-of replay.

tasks.deliverable: P4 synthetic fixture, Golden, annotation and replay qualification
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Golden fixtures cover exact subject/P3/World projection, machine evidence, instructor revision/audit, approval states, unavailable/OOD cases, role denial, deterministic logical identity and historical replay without P1/P2/P3 mutation.

Materialize exact composition-bound team/package/mission evidence preserving contributing subject IDs, roles, P4 revisions, aircraft/twin revisions and mission context; missing/unavailable member evidence remains explicit.

Any aggregation executes only an adopted exact profile/formula/weight/threshold authority; incompatible reference conditions/twin/configuration revisions are not pooled without explicit normalization authority; team result is never copied to individual subjects.

Publish deterministic P5 revision bound to exact composition/evidence/aggregation-profile identity, outcome-vs-performance semantics, approval/claim/validity/as-of state and provenance; composition or governed-input change creates a new revision.

tasks.deliverable: Composition-aware P5 longitudinal identity and replay
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Longitudinal P5 comparisons preserve composition identity and explicitly distinguish same-composition from changed-composition series; exact historical revisions/as-of replay remain available and no roster change is silently followed.

tasks.deliverable: Exact revision-bound P4/P5 API and authorized instructor workflow
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Expose exact P4/P5 revision reads and authorized/idempotent instructor annotation/approval writes with role-aware privacy projection; historical reads require exact IDs, never current/latest/default aliases, hidden recomputation or claim upgrade.

tasks.deliverable: P1/P2/P3 aircraft vs P4 individual vs P5 team/mission visible separation
tasks.minimum_acceptance: GUI visibly separates aircraft capability context, individual human-machine assessment and team/mission assessment; displays exact scope/revision/evidence origin/approval/validity/unavailable/uncertainty and role-sensitive visibility; no persistence, recomputation or claim upgrade in presentation code.

Runtime/API/GUI enforce frozen role projections, pseudonymous views and privileged audit evidence; unauthorized direct identity/evidence/export access fails closed and no sensitive payload is leaked to unrestricted logs.

During active M8 implementation refine M9/P6 using real P4/P5 evidence to task/interface/test detail, including fact-vs-projection separation, assumptions/model/applicability/uncertainty, approval/release and interoperability boundaries; no P6 implementation or admission is activated.

tasks.minimum_acceptance: Golden vectors verify exact composition identity, contributing members/roles/P4/P3 lineage, governed aggregation profile identity, explicit missing/unavailable states, changed-composition new identity and deterministic replay; negatives reject zero-fill, unauthorized pooling and individual/team result copying.
